title: "Workshop Python Image Analysis"

### Goals and philosophy

<font color=red>

The goals of this python-based workshop are to teach you:

- How to think about images on the computer
- Learn about tools to modify images 
- Which tools are available in Python
- How to practically build an image analysis-pipeline
- Some fundamentals of ML

The idea is *not* to train you in every single method that exists in image analysis.
We go over main ideas of image analysis, and the basics of how to manipulate images.

Once you know what types of possibilities and tools to look for, you can 
further explore them on your own using this thing called *the internet*.

Moreover, LLMs are currently omnipresent. They can be a very useful tool
in building your image analysis pipeline. However, they tend to HALLUCINATE
AND YOU DON'T KNOW WHAT TO ASK
SO NOW USE THEM TO ASK, BUT NOT TO CODE

WELCOME TO TALK TO US

- sth about Le Chat

</font>
